summary.text: Anita Burroughs is a Democratic state representative from Carroll 2 who has served in the House since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Burroughs has a background in marketing and business management.

paragraphs.text: Anita Burroughs was born in Jersey City, New Jersey, and earned a bachelor's degree from Brandeis University in 1977 and an MBA from Boston College in 1982.
Her professional experience includes marketing in the tech industry, running a catering business, and marketing and operations for a national healthcare consulting company.
She is affiliated with Starting Point, which provides services for victims of domestic and sexual violence.
Burroughs was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee in 2019-2020 and to the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
